Tickets & Opening Hours

Use the dated listing below for preparation, then confirm access and charges with staff.

Hours: dated Maps listing

Google Maps checked on 19 October 2026 lists 08:00–17:00 daily. This is not a guarantee of today’s access, every room or event arrangements.

Admission: confirm current charges

Indonesia.travel notes a visitor levy introduced in February 2024. Current amounts, categories and included services have not been verified; ask staff before paying.

Facilities and suggested duration

Ask about toilets, parking, capacity and accessible routes. As a planning suggestion, allow 45–90 minutes, adjusted to open rooms, your needs and any queues.

Frequently asked questions

01What are the opening hours?+

Maps checked 19 October 2026 lists 08:00–17:00 daily. Confirm current access with staff.

02How much is admission?+

Current prices are unverified. A historical levy reference does not establish today’s amount; ask at the entrance.

03Are facilities guaranteed?+

No. Ask staff about toilets, parking and accessibility before relying on them.
